annotations.title: Price limits per m2 in the family housing loan (BGK)

description: Use for the maximum price per m2 in the family housing loan without down payment (rodzinny kredyt mieszkaniowy, BGK guarantee) in a city or voivodeship, and to check if a flat qualifies. Give BGK as the source and the quarter. Maximum price per m2 of a flat that can be bought with the Polish family housing loan (rodzinny kredyt mieszkaniowy, "Mieszkanie bez wkładu własnego": mortgage without down payment, BGK guarantees the missing part), from the quarterly lists of Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego based on voivode announcements. 52 locations: each voivodeship city, the municipalities bordering it and all other municipalities. Two limits: first buyer from the developer and secondary market or cooperative right. Gives change vs previous quarter and year, history, an optional check of a price per m2 against the limit, and the finwire index finwire_rkm_offer_fit (share of developer price-list flats in voivodeship cities within the limit). Attribution to BGK is mandatory (not CC BY).

location.description: Voivodeship city (Kraków), voivodeship (małopolskie) or key (krakow, krakow-okolice, malopolskie-pozostale). Default: all voivodeship cities.

market.description: primary = first buyer from the developer, secondary = previous owner or cooperative right. Default primary.

price_per_m2.description: Price per m2 in PLN to check against the limit of the first matching location.

quarters.description: Number of past quarters in the history, default 4.
